Executive Abstract & Project Motivation

SRM IST Tiruchirappalli · School of Computing · Department of CSE

🎯 Evaluation Rubric: Abstract (5 Marks)
🌍 Context & The Tamil Nadu Problem
  • Global Food Crisis: 1.3 Billion tonnes of food wasted annually ($940B economic loss, 8-10% of global greenhouse gases).
  • Coastal Humidity Acceleration: In Tamil Nadu, coastal moisture regularly exceeds 90% RH, causing unpreserved street-vendor produce (Koyambedu wholesale) to spoil within 48–72 hours.
  • Commercial Fridge Failures: Samsung Family Hub & LG InstaView continuously stream raw kitchen video to cloud servers, violating user privacy under India's DPDPA 2023.
  • Proposed Innovation: FedCausalFreshNet (FCFN) is a privacy-first IoT ecosystem on Raspberry Pi 4B combining Flower Federated Learning, YOLOv8n, and DoWhy Causal Inference.
📊 Proven Quantitative Benchmarks
  • YOLOv8n Produce Detection: Custom trained on 5,000 Indian produce images; achieves mAP@50 = 0.893 and 94.1% thermal zone classification.
  • Flower FL Convergence: 92.3% global accuracy achieved in 10 communication rounds without raw image transmission.
  • DoWhy Causal Freshness Gain: Proves +2.8 to +5.2 days shelf-life extension via laminar airflow intervention.
  • Gemini Pro 1.5 GenAI: Contextual zero-waste recipe synthesis tailored to authentic Tamil Nadu cuisine (Poriyal, Thokku).
  • Household Impact: 34% waste reduction, saving ₹620/month per home.

Research Gaps Identified in Existing Works

Specific Technical Gaps Motivating the FedCausalFreshNet Architecture

🎯 Gap Identified (5 Marks)
🔒 GAP 1: Severe Privacy Invasions

Commercial smart fridges stream unencrypted internal camera feeds to cloud servers. Under India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act (DPDPA 2023) and GDPR, private home kitchens require on-device edge boundaries. No commercial appliance offers a federated zero-data-leakage architecture.

⚖️ GAP 2: The Correlation Fallacy in Food AI

Deep learning models only evaluate correlation P(Rot | Humidity, Door). They confuse monsoon humidity co-occurrence with door frequency. Judea Pearl's do-calculus P(Y | do(Zone=Back)) is required to mathematically isolate the true physical treatment effect of cold laminar airflow.

🌴 GAP 3: The Tamil Nadu Localization Void

Existing models are trained on Western supermarket produce with artificial cold-chains. None cater to unwashed, unpreserved street produce from Koyambedu and Uzhavar Sandhai (drumsticks, small shallots, Palak keerai) subjected to >90% coastal humidity.

🤝 GAP 4: Complete Absence of P2P Community Rescue

Households regularly discard surplus garden harvests or perishables before traveling because there is no privacy-preserving neighborhood exchange. Existing WhatsApp groups leak phone numbers and addresses; a zero-knowledge P2P protocol is needed.

System Architecture: Three-Tier Distributed Design

End-to-End Edge, Federation, and Application Infrastructure

🎯 Architectural Design for Proposed System (5 Marks)
🍓 TIER 1: EDGE DEVICE TIER
  • Raspberry Pi 4B (4GB RAM): Core host running Pi Camera Module v2 and DHT22 GPIO4 telemetry.
  • Volatile RAM Vision: YOLOv8n processes captured camera frames in memory; raw images are destroyed immediately.
  • Embedded Causal Engine: Lightweight DoWhy evaluator running on-device in 3.2 ms.
🌐 TIER 2: FEDERATED LEARNING TIER
  • Flower (flwr) Framework: Coordinates decentralized model aggregation across edge client nodes.
  • FedAvg Aggregation: Server receives only encrypted numerical weight vectors (no image data).
  • Differential Privacy: Calibrated Gaussian noise addition bounds privacy leakage under (ε, δ)-DP.
💻 TIER 3: APPLICATION & UI TIER
  • 3D Chamber Digital Twin: Three.js spatial chamber with real-time laminar airflow shaders.
  • Gemini Pro 1.5 GenAI: Culturally tailored zero-waste recipe generator with live cooking timers.
  • P2P Swarm Network: Gated society two-way surplus and emergency wishlist exchange.

Edge Dataflow & Chamber Micro-Climate Zones

Door-Triggered Execution Pipeline and Micro-Climate Classification

🎯 Architectural Design for Proposed System (5 Marks)
Door Closes → CSI Camera Capture (RAM) → YOLOv8n Detection → DHT22 Coastal Telemetry (92% RH) → DoWhy SCM Evaluation → 3D Twin Guidance
BACK CHILLER (LAMINAR JET)
Temp: 3.8°C | Airflow: 0.45 m/s

High-speed laminar cold stream sweeps away surface moisture film and dilutes ethylene gas. Extends Palak keerai and milk packets by +2.8 to +5.2 days.

MIDDLE PROTECTED SHELF
Temp: 4.2°C | Airflow: 0.28 m/s

Protected thermal equilibrium. Prevents chilling injuries: Bananas turn black below 4°C, but thrive in Middle Shelf gaining +1.8 days.

FRONT DOOR BALCONY
Temp: 6.5°C | Airflow: 0.05 m/s

Severe thermal shock zone exposed to 12-25 daily door openings during Chennai coastal heat. Accelerates rotting by -1.85 to -2.6 days.

Algorithms: Federated Averaging & YOLOv8n Core

Mathematical Formulations for Decentralized Learning & Object Recognition

🎯 Algorithms/Techniques Used (5 Marks)
ALGORITHM 1: PRIVACY FEDAVG (FLOWER)
w_{t+1} = ∑_{k=1}^K (n_k / n) · w_{t+1}^k
  • Local Gradient Optimization: Executed across 5 edge nodes with Adam optimizer and cosine learning rate decay.
  • Differential Privacy (DP): Gradient clipping at threshold C followed by Gaussian perturbation N(0, σ² C² I).
  • FedProx Regularization: Augmented with (μ/2)||w - w_t||² to eliminate divergence from non-IID household consumption.
ALGORITHM 2: YOLOv8n VISION & SPATIAL CORE
Head = [Class P(c), Sourcing P(s), ShelfZone P(z)]
  • Anchor-Free C2f Backbone: Optimizes gradient flow and small-object detection in crowded refrigerators.
  • Triple-Output Multi-Task Head: Simultaneously predicts class label, vendor origin (Street/Supermarket), and thermal shelf zone.
  • Edge Performance: 3–5 FPS on ARM Cortex-A72; achieves mAP@50 = 0.893 on custom dataset.

Algorithms: Causal Do-Calculus & Culinary GenAI

Structural Causal Modeling & Contextual Recipe Synthesis

🎯 Algorithms/Techniques Used (5 Marks)
ALGORITHM 3: DOWHY SCM BACKDOOR ADJUSTMENT
P(Y | do(T=Back)) = ∑_z P(Y | T=Back, Z=z) P(Z=z)
  • Confounder Set Z: Coastal Humidity (92%), Door Openings (12/d), Ethylene density.
  • Average Treatment Effect: ATE = +2.86 Days (p < 0.001) for Back Chiller.
  • Placebo Refutation Test: Passed (p = 0.98), proving zero spurious bias.
  • Random Common Cause: Robust with drift Δ < 0.02.
ALGORITHM 4: GEMINI PRO ZERO-WASTE GENAI
PriorityQueue = SortByAscending(DoWhy_Hours_To_Rot)
  • Urgency Heuristic: Forces ingredients with lowest freshness scores into recipe core.
  • Tamil Nadu Taxonomy: Poriyal (greens stir-fry), Thokku (3-week tomato preserve), Mor Kuzhambu (buttermilk stew).
  • Interactive Cooking Mode: Live simmer timers and 1-click inventory deduction upon dish completion.

Dataset Preparation: Custom Indian Produce Benchmark

5,000-Image Taxonomy, Augmentation Pipeline, and Stratified Partitioning

🎯 Dataset Preparation (5 Marks)
CUSTOM DATASET TAXONOMY
  • Volume: 5,000 high-resolution images covering 18 domestic produce classes (Salem drumstick, Koyambedu tomato, Palak, shallots, milk).
  • Dual-Source Labels: Tagged as 'Street Vendor' (unwashed/no cold chain) or 'Supermarket' (pre-waxed).
  • Thermal Coordinates: Bounding boxes annotated with Back Chiller, Middle, or Door Balcony ground truth.
AUGMENTATION & STRESS SIMULATION
  • Condensation Blur: Synthetic moisture droplet noise simulating 92% RH interior camera lens fogging.
  • Lighting Variations: Open-door kitchen halogen glare vs interior cold LED wash.
  • Occlusion Clustering: Multi-object overlapping simulating dense domestic Indian fridge shelves.
PARTITIONING & INTEGRITY
  • Stratified Split: 70% Train (3,500 imgs), 15% Validation (750 imgs), 15% Blind Test (750 imgs).
  • Class Balance: Focal loss weighting mitigating staple frequency vs seasonal fruits.
  • Privacy Protection: Verified zero human facial presence or domestic identifiers in tensors.

Anticipated Viva Voce / Panel Q&A Preparation

Scientific and Architectural Defenses to Key Panel Inquiries

🎯 Question and Answer (5 Marks)
Q1: Why Causal AI over Deep Learning?

Answer: Deep learning only models correlation P(Rot | Humidity, Door). Under coastal monsoon weather, door openings and 92% humidity co-occur, causing standard AI to misattribute spoilage to door frequency. Judea Pearl's do-calculus mathematically blocks this backdoor path, isolating the true physical effect of laminar airflow P(Rot | do(Zone=Back)) = +2.86 days.

Q2: How is Privacy Guaranteed under DPDPA 2023?

Answer: Privacy is enforced by architecture, not software policy. Captured images are loaded strictly into volatile RAM for YOLO inference and are immediately overwritten. No video or raw image ever touches persistent disk or external network interfaces. Only numerical model weight vectors with differential privacy noise leave the household.

Q3: Why FL over Centralized Cloud Training?

Answer: Domestic food images contain sensitive personal indicators (dietary restrictions, medications, household schedules). Cloud training violates user privacy and requires continuous high-bandwidth video uplinks. Flower FL trains models locally across 5 households and aggregates updates, achieving 92.3% accuracy while maintaining zero data transfer.

Q4: How do you prevent Chilling Injuries?

Answer: Certain fruits like Robusta Bananas suffer permanent cellular breakdown under 4°C (skin blackens and loses flavor). Our causal model identifies this hazard and deliberately assigns negative lift (-2.1d) to the Back Chiller for bananas, correctly guiding them to the Middle Shelf (+1.8d).
